meta.name: add-rtk
meta.description: Install rtk token-compression proxy into agent containers. Routes Bash tool calls through rtk for 60–90% token savings on dev commands (git, cargo, pytest, docker, kubectl, etc.).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在容器中安装 rtk 代理以压缩令牌，节省开发命令的令牌消耗
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果使用 AI 辅助开发且想减少令牌消耗
copy.tagline_en: Install rtk proxy in containers to compress tokens and save on dev commands
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use AI-assisted development and want to reduce token usage

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 执行 Bash 命令（如 git、cargo、pytest 等）时，会自动经由 rtk 代理压缩，减少 60–90% 的 token 消耗，无需额外指示。
howto.when: 安装完成后，每次 Claude 通过 Bash 工具运行命令时，rtk 的 PreToolUse 钩子会自动接管并过滤所有调用。

say.text: 帮我给当前 agent 组安装并配置 rtk。
say.note: 会执行安装、挂载和添加钩子。

say.text: 验证 rtk 是否已生效。
say.note: 会检查容器内版本和钩子配置。

say.text: 看看 rtk 节省了多少 token。
say.note: 运行 rtk gain 查看节省量。

howto.what_en: Once installed, when Claude runs Bash commands (e.g. git, cargo, pytest), traffic is routed through rtk, a token-compressing proxy, saving 60–90% on tokens with no extra prompting.
howto.when_en: Activated automatically on every Bash tool call after installation, via a PreToolUse hook that filters all commands through rtk.

say_en.text: Install and configure rtk for the current agent group.
say_en.note: Runs install, mount, and hook setup.
Checks the in-container version and hook config.

say_en.text: Show how many tokens rtk has saved.
say_en.note: Runs rtk gain to display savings.
